fields.rt-blog-html:
In an era when competition among restaurants is fierce—both on the plate and on social media—restaurants must be able to reinvent themselves and surprise their customers in order to attract an ever-growing number of diners.

That's good news, because innovation in your restaurant is only limited by your imagination, because there are hundreds of ideas to exploit!

Discover 13 innovative restaurant concepts today! 👇

‍

What innovative restaurant concept?

Concept #1: Del Arte opens more digital, nomadic and experiential restaurants

The concept behind the Italian restaurant chain Del Arte is a perfect example of innovation! With a more digital, mobile, and experiential approach, the chain aims to stay as closely aligned as possible with its guests’ evolving expectations. 

How? With a completely redesigned restaurant featuring multiple atmospheres, capable of attracting customers at any time of day and regardless of their preferences (dine-in, takeout, for drinks before dinner, for sports or music events, etc.). The goal is to break away from the chain’s traditional norms by offering three different customer experiences.

For example, by setting up a large counter-style bar, a click-and-collect area for online orders, a fully digital experience using QR codes, or even giving customers the chance to watch their own pizzas being prepared… and much more!

Concept n°2 : Flunch's fun restaurants

The famous Flunch chain has also decided to revamp its concept! 

With a more modern and playful vibe, it has focused on entertainment. This includes a bar area open all day, cozier seating areas, informative displays about the origin and nature of the products, and modular, customizable themed cubes. The restaurant aims to be decidedly youthful and innovative!

The concept will be rolled out in 100 restaurants between 2023 and 2024.

‍

The restaurant concepts that work

Concept n°3 : Asian street food, example with Itsu

With its new restaurant, Itsu, the Bertrand Group is continuing its expansion by focusing on Asian street food, a concept that originated in England.

The first restaurants, which are opening one after another in the capital and will be available for franchising in 2024, offer more than fifty hot and cold Asian dishes in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Makis, gyozas, rice-pot, sushis, broths, desserts like mochis, all with the possibility to be served in 2 minutes, thanks to a 100% digital customer path!

‍

Concept #4: Fast food, simply put

In 2024, fast food continues to grow in popularity! Before choosing your concept, it’s helpful to know the six profitable fast-food models that are taking the market by storm.

Why is this? There are many reasons: 

  • Fast food and healthy eating: Gone are the days when fast food was associated solely with American burger chains. Today, it’s entirely possible to eat healthy—and even organic—at these restaurants. For example, many fast-food restaurants offer salads, 100% homemade and organic burgers, or even exclusively vegan or vegetarian options!
  • Bright growth prospects: Revenue in this market has been rising for the past ten years (between 8% and 12% per year!)

The most important point remains this: the digitalization of the points of sale.

And for good reason: digital technology is essential in the fast-food industry! It helpsstreamline all tasks—especially the most time-consuming ones—whether it’s taking orders, processing payments, preparing food in the kitchen, or delivering meals. You have to know how to adapt to Generation Z! 

A comprehensive digital solution can revolutionize your business. No more wasting time—and therefore money—which also causes stress among your staff. You’ll finally be able to focus fully on your business!

👉 To go further: discover the testimony of Alfi, which increased its average basket by 28%.

Concept 5: Immersive restaurants like Ephemera

This experience transforms the restaurant into a place of entertainment, where every meal becomes an adventure in itself.

In Paris, several restaurants are embracing this innovative concept, offering interactive culinary experiences that leave a lasting impression.

For example, the Ephemera group has launched 3 immersive restaurants in Paris:

  • "Under The Sea
  • "Stellar
  • and"Jungle Palace

These restaurants reflect a growing trend in the foodservice sector that emphasizes innovation and customer experience.

Concept No. 6: A Return to Local and Regional Products—The Example of Basilic and Co

Reinventing yourself and innovating sometimes means going back to basics!

Basilic and Co is a perfect example of this, with its focus on local sourcing and community ties. The franchise is now expanding in western France with the opening of three new locations.

What’s the concept? Pizza—but not just any pizza, since the chain is the gold standard for regional pizzas in France. Direct relationships with producers (no central purchasing agency) ensure high-quality ingredients, the menu is updated twice a year, and the dough is 100% homemade… A return to authenticity from a franchise that’s still profitable and resilient!

Speaking of franchising, we have written a guide to opening a fast food franchise!

Concept n°7 : vegetarian cuisine innovates with the Vietgétarienne Canteen

Launched in 2022 by the Phood Group as a full-scale pilot, this 100% plant-based Vietnamese street food concept remains based in Paris, where it continues to appeal to fans of healthy Asian cuisine. (Source: Newtable)

It positions itself as a Vietnamese street-style gourmet spot, setting itself apart from the competition in meaningful ways! Healthy, ethically prepared dishes made on-site, using fresh and organic ingredients—especially for drinks and herbal teas. All this in a unique atmosphere, where you can enjoy a meal at any time of day!

‍

Restaurants with an original concept

Since a restaurant's unique concept can really make a difference, check out some ideas for unconventional restaurants!

Concept n°8 : a culinary voyage with Cahupa

The concept? A card around the theme of travel.

Want to travel around the world without leaving France? Let's meet at Cahupa in Angers! What's on the agenda? A map around the theme of travel. 

The concept behind this unique and charming establishment comes from three childhood friends who joined forces to create a bar-restaurant serving cocktails and dishes to share, inspired by cuisines from around the world. And the best part? It’s all homemade! It’s sure to attract travelers and dreamers eager to discover new culinary horizons.

Concept n°9 : Cooking with the Braise flame

Braise opened its doors in Paris in September 2022. Its cuisine features an urban grill, where the flame becomes an extension of the chef’s arm—or rather, of its chef, Sylvain Courivaud.

Authentic cuisine with an original concept. A skillfully controlled play of flames can only enhance the flavor of octopus, a Limousin beef rib, or even a seared leek. 

‍Authenticand singular, the restaurant offers 5 starters, 4 main courses and 3 desserts every three weeks. Enough to constantly innovate to surprise the regulars!

‍

Trendy concepts in catering

Innovation isn't limited to fast food and traditional restaurants! Yes, creative dining concepts are also found in institutional food service.

Concept n°10 : when foodservice focuses on fresh, local and organic produce

In the institutional food service sector, the industry has also grown. And for good reason: local and organic products are now required. 

Indeed, the process began with a law coming into force on January 1, 2020, where the National Assembly voted a provision requiring the introduction of 40% local or seasonal products, and 20% organic products, in public catering. 

The establishments had to follow the movement for the greatest pleasure of the guests!

This is the case of 11H59, which has rethought the catering industry not only in terms of the plate but also in terms of the guest experience.

👉 To go further: Testimony of David Pascolo, Project Director at 11H59

Concept n°11 : when foodservice includes corners

It's not just the products that have changed in institutional food service. Dining areas are also undergoing a revolution! 

Gone are the days of the basic cafeteria—make way for corner-style spaces: themed kiosks, food trucks, salad bars, sandwich counters, and even a coffee shop. Everything is more modern, fun, and appealing! Among these formats, opening a food truck remains one of the most flexible options for testing a concept before setting up a permanent location.

This is the case, for example, with French Terroirs, which has completely revamped its offerings. In its space—which feels more like a trendy food court than a company cafeteria—you’ll find a grocery section, a pastry shop, and even a bar and a terrace for after-work gatherings! The restaurant isn’t just for employees, by the way. Anyone can pull up a chair and have lunch. To streamline operations, French Terroirs partnered with Innovorder, which deployed its all-in-one digital ecosystem for order taking, payment processing, operations management, and the administration of subsidies and grants.

👉 To go further: Discover Innovorder solutions for corporate catering

Concept n°12 : 2024, the year of channel partnerships

Some institutional catering establishments are also developing partnerships with chains.

Grocery, bakery, and pastry chains… Just what’s needed to make institutional food service more glamorous!

This is the case for the Elior group, which has begun a partnership with Berliner Das Original and Meglio in a company restaurant in Plessis-Robinson.

Concept no. 13: PopChef 's self-service restaurant!

You've probably heard of vending. But have you ever heard of vending?

Contrary to popular belief, it, too, can be healthy, varied, and balanced! That’s the challenge PopChef, a socially conscious Parisian startup, has set for itself. 

Full meals and beverages available all day long thanks to a connected refrigerator. This is sure to reinvent the customer experience by adapting to the latest digital trends. 

Fun and practical, this concept is becoming more and more popular in companies!
